title: Quantum codes from classical annealing
summary: We introduce an adaptive simulated annealing algorithm to search for moderately-sized quantum error-correcting codes with high encoding rates and large distances. Our search targets two classes of stabilizer codes: (1) CSS codes, and (2) a subclass of CSS codes that we call ``self-dual with equivalent logicals'' (SWEL) codes, the latter of which which admit transversal implementations of logical Hadamard and phase gates that can be leveraged to construct fault-tolerant gate sets.
